finalText:
Build's clean now. Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump.

`resolveRetries` in `src/core/options.js` was still reading `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. It threw on every build.

`isBackoffEnabled` in `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false`. The new config loader leaves unset flags as `undefined`, so it threw too. Now `undefined` is treated as disabled.

Build exits 0, retries resolve to 3, backoff resolves to disabled. The rest of the warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, not errors.
